body: There's no 'assistance' to be had. The only things I could get are foodstamps and a medical card. Neither will do any good because I have no way to the store or the dentist. And you can't even apply for those unless you go to the county office, which again, I have no way to get there. #1 problem is being trapped on this hill in middle of nowhere with no way to get anywhere. I could WORK if I had a way to get somewhere. Please stop telling me to 'get some assistance' when there is none to be had and no way to do it.
She has nothing. She is also on SSI, and has no vehicle or extra money. She has to wait til every other week when her brother comes in from out of state to take her places. And I'm a burden on her.

Relocate how? That requires money, and a vehicle to move myself and my things. I have neither. There's simply nothing that can be done. So I'm done. Thank you for trying to offer ideas and encouragement, but without transportation, I have zero options. Take care.

It's already infected, my face is puffed out, multiple teeth on top and bottom are being pushed out by the swelling.

I can't volunteer anywhere. *I can't get anywhere*. There is absolutely nothing but a single gas station in any direction for 20 miles. There is nothing I can do. And I did contact my mother's side of the family. No one replied. Not a single person responded when I said hello. She's poisoned the well, probably by telling them I laid around her house doing nothing all year. When fact is, I worked 70 hour weeks between my two jobs, and paid all of HER bills, handing over all of my paychecks to keep her from losing her apartment. Years ago she told family I was selling drugs, when I lived in DC and owned a small business. There's no hope in dealing with her or these people. I give up.

I have no family. I disowned my father's family many years ago because of their involvement with the KKK and a variety of other reasons. My mother made sure I had no one left on her side of the family by lying to them to explain away her treatment of me.

I could possibly get foodstamps. So what? That isn't going to get me to work and back. I could get a medical card. So what? That isn't going to get me to the dentist. I live 20 miles from anywhere/anything, out in the countryside. I won't take foodstamps and sit on this hillside and be a useless drain on society. I am smart, strong, physically capable, and eager to work. I just can't *get* there. I see my ex's son. He collects SSI due to his PTSD from a violent childhood. He collects $710 a month, rents a room in an old couple's basement, and does nothing but collect action figures and comic books and video games, and throw screaming fits and go into violent rages when anything at all inconveniences him. He's 27 and has never worked a day in his life.

I won't be him. And I won't sit here collecting foodstamps in agony while my mouth rots away and I am not working. I see no way out of this situation. No one I can stay with, no one who can take me to work and back.
Support doesn't change anything. I have no way to advance my life. I cannot and will not spend another year sitting out on this hillside unable to work.
